title: Agent Pulse
description: One daily evidence-backed decision brief from the coding-agent projects monitored by The Git Reporter.

scope.coverageStatement: V0.2 reports one dated decision brief from direct public source evidence and keeps git motion as a secondary measurement layer. Community feedback metrics are absent until a reproducible feedback collector ships.

inputs.dailyInsight: reported, date-owned Agent Pulse decision brief

editorialRead.headline: Morning Read — October 13, 2026
editorialRead.readHeadline: openclaw/openclaw is the first source to inspect.
editorialRead.oneLineSummary: openclaw/openclaw leads a 3-item attention queue backed by direct receipts; 29 watchlist sources are fresh, 0 need source-health attention, and movement still requires editorial judgment.
editorialRead.dek: Agent Pulse filtered 29 included projects down to 3 items worth finite newsroom attention. The queue protects attention; it does not declare winners.
bullets: openclaw/openclaw — 221 commits today, 294.6 below its current daily pace, with 260 hardening-subject points. Inspect the receipt before assigning a story.
NousResearch/hermes-agent — 24 commits landed today. Keep it on watch, but require the next receipt to prove a reader consequence before promoting it.
microsoft/agent-framework — No same-day commit after 77 commits in the seven-day window. The pause is notable enough to preserve, not enough to turn into a story.
editorialRead.watchNext: The next meaningful upgrade is feedback flow: issues opened and closed, review latency, stale backlog, and the share of work that starts outside the maintainer team.
editorialRead.caveat: Source-code motion and article coverage are collected. GitHub issue flow, PR review timing, community discussion, and private backlog signals are not.

dailyInsight.headline: OpenHands adds controls for cloud sessions
dailyInsight.insight: Agent Canvas can create and connect to OpenHands sessions on DigitalOcean, with separate controls for disconnecting the interface, pausing work and destroying a session.
dailyInsight.mechanism: A session-specific tunnel exposes the remote agent server as a Canvas backend. Attaching resumes a paused session before connecting; browser support requires the optional server bridge.
dailyInsight.whyItMatters: People evaluating remote agent work can distinguish leaving the interface from ending the remote session.

actions.label: Watch a complete session lifecycle
actions.instruction: Look for a reproducible v1.27.1 task trace that covers pause, resume after client restart, Disconnect only and Stop session, including the resulting task output and billed runtime.
actions.effort: One focused trace review; no deployment change

receipts.title: Canvas integration and session lifecycle
receipts.supports: Backend selection, resume-before-attach and separate remote lifecycle controls.

receipts.title: OpenHands v1.27.1
receipts.supports: Containing release also includes the Docker bridge-module packaging repair.

confidence.basis: Pinned lifecycle code, source test cases and release ancestry inspected. Upstream reports a real-account browser check; no independent cloud execution.

dailyInsight.limitation: The cloud service is in public preview. Source and release inspection do not measure completed-task reliability, spend or self-improvement.
dailyInsight.falsifier: A pinned released trace cannot restore the same paused session, or Disconnect only unexpectedly destroys remote work.
dailyInsight.watchNext: A repeatable v1.27.1 task through client restart, with pause, disconnect and stop outcomes distinguished.
